verdict.rationale: The API reference identifies itself as Stark Bank's "second API version," which shows explicit API versioning. The docs also promise to "avoid breaking changes at all costs" so integrations won't stop working. However, there is no documented deprecation policy: no sunset timelines, deprecation notices, version-pinning mechanism or migration windows. missing for 10: a formal deprecation/sunset policy with timelines and notification process, documented version-selection mechanics (e.g. URL or header versioning), a changelog, and independent corroboration.
